text:
zoe: Noticed a regression in canary: when runtime 3.4.0 is pinned for model ravenx, streaming sessions sometimes drop mid-kv-sync. Planning to soft-unpin across low-traffic regions to confirm.

eng-sre: how severe? any customer impact yet?

zoe: only internal canaries and a few nightly e2e failures. No public incidents. Repro: short stream, then 100ms gap, next chunk never arrives; runtime logs kv-sync timeout.

devx: agree with soft-unpin. Suggest sequence: ap-northeast -> sa-east -> eu-central -> us-central with 10m validation windows. Add a routing fallback header to force model=ravenx-compat if needed.

ops_jun: deploy-bot, run the unpin for ap-northeast and attach job id. Keep rollback playbook ready.

deploy-bot: command received: `unpin runtime 3.4.0 --model ravenx --regions ap-northeast --mode soft`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6173339001).

qa-bot: running smoke tests on ap-northeast once job completes. Script: `curl -s -X POST https://api.ap-northeast.redwood/v1/stream -d '{"model":"ravenx","input":"long stream test","stream":true}'` repeated 5x.

deploy-bot: ap-northeast unpin complete (job=JB6173339001) 1:05 UTC status=OK

qa-bot: smoke: 5/5 succeeded, p95 latency within baseline. No kv-sync timeouts observed.

zoe: good. proceed to sa-east. ops_jun, please monitor 5xx and stream-drop metrics.

ops_jun: starting sa-east unpin now. deploy-bot please queue.

deploy-bot: command received: `unpin runtime 3.4.0 --model ravenx --regions sa-east --mode soft`
deploy-bot: job queued (job=JB6173339002)

deploy-bot: sa-east unpin complete (job=JB6173339002) 1:25 UTC status=OK

qa-bot: sa-east smoke: 4/5 succeeded, 1 stream-drop observed. Logging to INF-4601.

eng-sre: INF-4601 shows a client-side backpressure followed by runtime timeout; need to check if SDK 3.0.1 changed flow control.

zoe: hold further unpins (eu-central/us-central) until INF-4601 triage. We should not propagate a possible regression.

ops_jun: deploy-bot, cancel queued job for eu-central (job=JB6173339003) per hold.

deploy-bot: queued job JB6173339003 cancelled per request.

devx: draft release-note snippet: "Temporarily soft-unpinned runtime 3.4.0 for ravenx in select regions while we investigate streaming kv-sync timeouts. If you see stream disconnects, add header `X-Runtime-Fallback: ravenx-compat` to route to compatible variant."

zoe: +1, ping support and eng-sre on the advisory. Also add rollback criteria: trigger pin back if stream-drop rate > 0.3% OR any customer errors reported.

ops_jun: opening INF-4601 ticket with SDK+runtime teams, attaching sample trace. Will update this thread with RCA and final release note.

eng-sre: thanks. If we need a rollback, command will be `pin runtime 3.4.0 --model ravenx --regions <region> --force`. Keep that handy.

zoe: closing for now until triage complete. Leave thread open for updates.
